posts.headline: Did You Know?
posts.body:
Sugar doesn't directly rot your teeth.
Bacteria eat sugar and produce acid — the acid destroys enamel.
posts.cta: The real culprit is acid, not sugar.

posts.headline: Fact
posts.body:
Green tea extract increases fat burning by 17% during exercise.
The EGCG compound activates fat oxidation enzymes.
posts.cta: Green tea is a real fat burner.
